styles.name: Tibard chef trousers, elasticated waist with drawstring and back pocket — long (tall) length, blue/white chef check
styles.desc: Chefs trousers · Full elasticated waist with drawstring · Zip fly · One patch pocket on the back · Side seam pockets · Hemmed · Long (tall) length · Blue and white chef check gingham
styles.lectra: NEW 3082 — variant NEW3082LL, long length; sizes 46" to 60" cut on the XXL to 5XL patterns
fabrics: Blue and white chef check gingham 65% polyester / 35% cotton 190 gsm (P and R) — the sheet gives no rating; 1.65 m from All Costings (the regular length is 1.60). The sheet puts PC2026 at C4; Sage has it at D3
trims: White Coats Epic 80's. Sage carries no white Epic 80's; costed on the white Perma Core 75 as the other white trousers
6" (15 cm) white lightweight nylon zip. Sage holds only the white 13 cm moulded zip; no code for the 15 cm white lightweight zip yet.
White plastic oval two-hole spring toggle on the drawstring. Sage holds only the black spring toggle; no code for the white yet.

48 mm white elastic with the white drawstring insert. Cut, and double stitch to secure: XS 22" (56 cm) · S 24" (61 cm) · M 28" (71 cm) · L 31" (79 cm) · XL 33" (84 cm) · XXL 35" (89 cm) · 46" 36" (91.5 cm) · 48" 38" (96.5 cm) · 50" 40" (101.5 cm) · 52" 42" (106.5 cm) · 54" 44" (111.5 cm) · 56" 46" (116.5 cm) · 58" 48" (121.5 cm) · 60" 50" (126.5 cm). Sage holds the plain white 48 mm Bonadex elastic; no code for the drawstring-insert elastic yet.

Tibard printed care label set into the back rise seam, 8 cm down from the finished top edge: 65% polyester 35% cotton · 60° wash · do not bleach · tumble dry low · 2 dot iron · can be dry cleaned. Printed at Tibard on the 25 mm nylon label tape.
Tibard tax tab set to the side edge of the back pocket (outside leg side of the pocket), the top of the label to the base of the pocket hem stitching.
mfg: Cut the elastic to the size (see the Elastic trim line) and double stitch to secure.

Set the buttonholes vertical for the drawstring, 1/2" buttonhole setting. Set equally within the width of the fly placket (2 cm gap between the buttonholes), the top of the buttonhole 6.5 cm from the top overlocked edge of the band, to finish within the centre gap of the stitch lines.
5 thread join up: pocket bags to the legs, outside leg seam, front and back rises, inside leg seam.
Set the back pocket hem double turned and topstitched 1.5 cm.
Top of the finished pocket set level with the notch in the back outside leg. Pocket set centrally within the width of the back leg and parallel to the top edge.
Fold in 1 cm and edgestitch the pocket down onto the back leg.
Edgestitch the front side pocket opening. Pocket opening to finish 17 cm.
Set the zip and topstitch the fly. Fly width 4 cm, curved at the base.
Edgestitch the front rise from the base of the fly stitching.
Overlock the top edge of the trouser. Set the elastic to the waist: 4 rows of stitching on the waist, twin needle at the top and twin needle at the base.
Trouser hem double turned 1 + 1.7 cm and topstitched 1.5 cm.
fin: Plastic oval two-hole toggle placed on the drawstring, the ends of the drawstring tied into a double knot.
Bartack horizontal across the top and bottom of the side pocket opening. Bartack vertical at the back pocket patch opening. Bartack vertical at the base of the fly.
Check and trim. Fold into quarters.
styles.tol: Waist relaxed, waist stretched, leg length and hips ± 2 cm
styles.note: Stock works order CTT3082--26, the long (tall) leg of CT3082--26 and the blue and white chef check colourway of CTT3082--03 (NEW 3082 variant NEW3082LL; JH created 24/4/14 to be the exact fit of the OH Lancashire trouser waist with the style details of the previous CT3082; 1/2" buttonhole blade setting YL 9/4/15; big sizes JH 7/2/17; cut cord lengths YL 16/6/21; Tibard Style added YL 9/10/24). The same trousers as CT3082--26 with a 34" (86.5 cm) leg in place of 32". This tall sheet runs to 60" with the cord and elastic cut lengths for every size. Sizes XS to XXL on the lettered Sage codes (CTT3082XS26, CTT3082SS26 … CTT3082XXL26) and 46" to 60" on the waist-size codes (CTT30824626 … CTT30826026). Sheet gives no rating; 1.65 m from All Costings. The sheet is in works-orders/CTT3082-26-Stock.xlsx.

styles.name: Suffolk chef jacket for Sapporo — long sleeve, black, double breasted, concealed stud, breast pocket with logo, no piping (Tibard branded)
styles.desc: Long sleeved double breasted jacket with concealed studs · Wrap collar with capped stud · Back darts · Long sleeves with V split cuff · Pen pocket on the left sleeve as worn · Breast pocket to the left front as worn, embroidered pre make-up · No piping: the front edge seam is edgestitched · Tibard branded product
styles.lectra: OH6LSLV — Suffolk, long sleeves, variant SAPPORO. Use the marker for the piped Suffolk jacket: this product still has the separate split facing even though it is not piped
fabrics: Black 65% polyester / 35% cotton 195 gsm (P & R) — rated 1.70 m on the sheet, All Costings agrees. The sheet names PC2003 at B11; Sage and All Costings carry the sustainable PC2003ECO (Tiajo) at B1
trims: THREAD — COATS EPIC 80'S BLACK 09700 — cost per metre

5 x nickel plated ring press studs. Concealed studs on the front set pre make-up (use the marker), with an additional stud on the inside lower front facing to hold the front in position. Lower studs set on the automatic machine.
1 x black plastic capped stud at the collar (use the marker).
Set centrally to the back panel, 4 cm down from the finished neck seam. Edgestitch in position in thread the same colour as the garment.
Tibard centre fold label at the centre back neck.
Set to the left side seam as worn, 10 cm up from the cut hem, to finish 8 cm from the finished hem.

Tibard printed care label: 65% polyester 35% cotton · 60° wash · 2 dot iron · tumble dry low · P dry clean · do not bleach. Set into the centre back neck seam underneath the Tibard centre fold label. Printed at Tibard on the 25 mm nylon label tape.
mfg: Breast pocket embroidered pre make-up (see the branding band). Set the concealed studs to the front pre make-up (use the marker). Note the additional stud on the inside lower front facing to hold the front in position.
Make the collar and edgestitch.
Join the facing to the front and edgestitch the seam. No piping.
Pen pocket hem double turned 1 + 2 cm and topstitched 2 cm.
Pen pocket set to the left sleeve as worn, to finish 12 cm down from the top of the sleeve seam. The back side of the pen pocket in line with the centre line of the sleeve.
Make the sleeve split at the hem: bag out at the underarm seam to form the V split, to finish 3.5 cm.
Sleeve hem double turned 1 cm + 4 cm and topstitched 4 cm.
Set the darts at the back. Using the notches take in 5 mm to nothing 1 cm past the drill hole.
5 thread join up: join the shoulder seams, join the right front to the front facing, set the collar, set the sleeves, set the sleeve underarm and side seam.
Body hem double turned 1 cm + 2.5 cm and topstitched 2.5 cm.
6 mm topstitch the back neck edge and onto the front to the width of the facing. The front stitching will vary in width as the facing is graded through the sizes.

Set the breast pocket, 11 cm wide × 11.5 cm high with mitred bottom corners. Pocket hem overlocked, turned 1.5 cm and topstitched 1 cm. Set to the left front as worn, 4 cm up from the raw edge of the armhole and 1 cm in from the facing stitching. Edgestitch in position and reinforce the top corners with a triangle tack.
Mark and set the lower studs on the automatic machine.
Mark and set the collar stud (use the marker).
fin: Bartack the top of the pen pocket and the sleeve split.
Mark and set the collar capped stud (use the marker).
Set the lower studs on the automatic machine.
After make-up the jacket goes back to embroidery for the name above the pocket (see the separate embroidery sheet).
styles.tol: Chest ± 2 cm · Sleeve ± 1 cm · Back ± 1.5 cm
styles.brandPlace: Sapporo logo set centrally to the breast pocket, 1772 gold with white text, embroidered pre make-up. After make-up the jacket goes back to embroidery for the name above the pocket (on the separate embroidery sheet)
styles.note: Works order CJSUFFOLK--03S, the black long sleeve Suffolk for Sapporo, a Tibard branded product (OH6LSLV variant SAPPORO; JH created 8/5/13 from SR677 for Sapporo; sleeve image YL 4/10/14; OH hem tabs to OH branding YL 15/5/15; updated for bulk from SR678 JH 14/11/18; stud marker details JH 1/12/20; logo colour orange to gold JH 14/7/22; edgestitching of the front seam JH 3/10/22).
